blocking_findings.title: Formal source conflict resolution revives an unchanged active skill that omits the conflict and conditions
blocking_findings.frozen_requirement: A09-02 preserves all source provenance and conflicts/applicability; A09-03 only accepted skill versions enter current use.
reproduction: Create and independently accept/promote a legitimate skill with four sources and no conflicts.
Add an EVIDENCE Conflict against two of its sources; GetActiveSkillContext correctly denies because conflict is OPEN.

Use a source-bound ADVISORY Decision, integration Task/current ContextBundle, sealed proposed decision value and independent ChangeProposal acceptance to apply the resolution. Conflict becomes RESOLVED.

Call GetActiveSkillContext again for the unchanged original ACTIVE skill. It succeeds, returns its original document.conflicts=[] and conflict_ids=[], without incorporating or independently accepting the new applicability conditions.
blocking_findings.expected: Use remains denied until an accepted skill version discloses the newly known resolved conflict and current accepted applicability conditions.
blocking_findings.actual: GetActiveSkillContext returned the original skill document without error immediately after the separate source resolution applied.
blocking_findings.root_cause: skillConflictLedgerCurrent and validateSkillSources were added only to acceptance and promotion; ResolveActiveSkill calls skillCurrent, whose conflict logic blocks OPEN conflicts but does not validate the RESOLVED ledger or adopted resolution conditions.
blocking_findings.minimal_remediation: At the shared active skill use boundary, recheck current conflict ledger and sealed skill document conditions against the current accepted source resolution, including historical proof/source currentness. Keep author assertions and original P1 fixes unchanged.

passed_scope: 6 resolution input negatives: wrong Conflict subject, omitted decision source input, omitted evidence source, substituted source evidence, unrelated integration Task, omitted value source; each denied without changing Conflict OPEN.
Verifier revoked after acceptance, a newly added unmatched conflict, source withdrawn after acceptance, and wrong acceptance ID all block apply and leave Conflict OPEN.
Original suite shrink, negative injection relabel and undisclosed OPEN source conflict P1 probes still denied.
Author formal resolution positive and resolved-ledger acceptance check passed; the selected Decision remains context-usable after Conflict revision advances.
Existing DecisionReceipt lineage integration TestW04C04 passed.
limits: Public product HTTP handlers and actual temporary SQLite are used by the fixture helpers; no real product database, live provider or protected store is accessed.
Trusted fixture principal provisioning and W10 runtime observation/measurement seams remain synthetic; these are not LIVE qualifications.
The source-withdrawal negative invokes the existing local trusted service put transition to REVOKED; the positive conflict-resolution flow does not mutate business tables directly.
Active skill consumption is tested through the production GetActiveSkillContext service boundary; no HTTP endpoint for this exact read is invented.
Initial test harness compile failed because of a misnamed existing helper; attempt-1 files are preserved. Corrected harness then executed the product probes and found the real use-boundary failure.
No full lifecycle/package run was performed; only new boundary tests, the original3 relevant P1 tests and affected formal resolution/C04 tests ran.
acceptance_recommendation: Do not accept A09 or whole W15 until W15-ACTIVE-LEDGER-04 is repaired and its targeted delta passes.
